en: Changed sandboxed commands on macOS, Linux and WSL to no longer write to some sensitive home folders by default; some can be allowed with `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` in user or managed settings
zh: 变更了 macOS、Linux 和 WSL 上的沙箱命令，使其默认不再写入某些敏感主目录文件夹；部分文件夹可通过用户或托管设置中的 `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite` 允许写入
